items.headline: How Each Music Listening Platform Is Treating AI Music (Updating)
items.excerpt: From BandCamp's ban of AI music to Spotify's "AI Personas," here's how all the online music platforms are dealing with the flood of AI songs.

items.headline: Chinese Tech Giant Alibaba Launches New AI Music Generator Called ‘Happy Shrimp’
items.excerpt: Partnering with Chinese major TAIHE MUSIC GROUP, Alibaba's AI music generator Happy Shrimp uses artificial intelligence to make fully produced songs.

items.headline: Billboard Affirms Commitment to Transparency Around AI-Generated Music
items.excerpt: Billboard announces commitment to creating transparency around the use of AI in music, including identifying songs on its charts that use AI.

items.headline: Guilt-Free AI: These 6 AI music tools actually pay the artists behind them
items.excerpt: LANDR, Moises AI, Voice-Swap and more: the AI music plugins that license their training data and share revenue with the artists behind it

items.headline: Dr. Dre says he is “embracing” AI in music: “It’s a new tool for creativity”
items.excerpt: “I think the only people that see it as a threat are the people who have trouble creating,” Dr. Dre says.

items.headline: Nearly 40% of music released last month used AI
items.excerpt: Almost a quarter was fully AI generated

items.headline: “It fundamentally changes how quickly musicians can build sounds”: Neural DSP adds Device Presets and expands Quad Cortex functionality in huge update that’ll help you spend less time tweaking
items.excerpt: CorOS and Cortex Control 4.1.0 expands plugin compatibility, adds eight new virtual devices and supports multiple device management – but are Device Presets the game-changer?

items.headline: Beatport Now Bans Fully AI-Generated Music, Effective Immediately: New Detection Tool in Action
items.excerpt: Beatport is banning fully AI-generated music and rolling out the Beatdapp detection tool to enforce it. 77% of DJs say they want music from real artists.

items.headline: ARIA blocks AI-generated recordings from Australia’s official charts
items.excerpt: The updated ARIA Charts Code of Practice takes effect from the chart dated August 31, which is published on August 28.

items.headline: Judge refuses to dismiss indie artist’s proposed class action against Suno, clearing AI output and stream-ripping claims for discovery
items.excerpt: Only one count fell: a claim under the Tennessee Consumer Protection Act, which the plaintiffs told the court they had cited by mistake.

items.headline: Universal Music JV Licenses 24+ AI Patents to Udio and GRAI
items.excerpt: Universal Music has licensed north of two dozen AI patents to Udio and GRAI via its 'Music IP Holdings' JV with Liquidax.

items.headline: Cleaning Up Vocal Rips With LALAL.AI Lynx
items.excerpt: Grabbing vocal samples from the internet or vinyl? Here’s how to clean up voice rips with LALAL.AI and its new algorithm, Lynx, and use them in tracks.

items.headline: AI detected in 40% of music released in July, study reveals
items.excerpt: By analysing over a million releases, SubmitHub’s AI music detector found that the use of AI in production is prevalent
